name: Ledyba
fl: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Rowlet

atk.x: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

ab.x: If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs.

fl: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

name: Gossifleur
fl: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Growlithe

atk.x: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

fl: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

name: Victini

atk.x: You may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

fl: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Lapras

atk.x: Search your deck for up to 2 Melony cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

fl: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Pikachu

atk.x: Attach a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

fl: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

name: Chinchou
fl: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Flaaffy
fl: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Tynamo

ab.x: If this Pokémon has any Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

fl: One alone can emit only trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Cutiefly
fl: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

name: Bewear

atk.x: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

fl: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

name: Pangoro

atk.x: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

fl: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

name: Drampa

atk.x: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 90 more damage.

fl: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Smeargle

atk.x: Reveal any number of basic Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 30 more damage for each type of basic Energy you revealed in this way.

fl: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.
